issues.detail: The Greek 'αναστας' (anastas) is a participle meaning 'rising up' or 'having risen.' The Vietnamese translation 'đứng dậy' (stood up) is grammatically acceptable, but the phrase 'Bấy giờ' (Now/At that time) is an addition not present in the Greek text.

The Greek phrase 'η ουσα αιρεσις των σαδδουκαιων' (the doctrine of the Sadducees) is entirely omitted in the Vietnamese translation. This is a substantive conceptual loss, as it identifies the specific belief system being reacted to.
